annotation.title_clean: IEEE P7009.1 – IEEE Draft Standard for Safety Management of Autonomous and Semi-Autonomous Systems–Interventions in the Event of Anomalous Behavior
annotation.title_en: IEEE P7009.1 – IEEE Draft Standard for Safety Management of Autonomous and Semi-Autonomous Systems–Interventions in the Event of Anomalous Behavior
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association – Reliability Society Standards Committee (RS/SC)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA project page for P7009.1, a draft standard on safety management of autonomous and semi-autonomous systems. It defines capabilities for interventions when such systems behave anomalously, as part of an operational Safety Management System. The page also lists the related IEEE 7009-2024 standard on fail-safe design.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines capabilities that help operational autonomous and semi-autonomous systems stay free from unacceptable risk of harm
Provides a basis for interventions when systems behave anomalously
Intended to be an integral part of an operational Safety Management System
Related standard IEEE 7009-2024 sets a technical baseline for fail-safe mechanisms in autonomous systems
